content.short: Pillar is a self-custody smart wallet with cross-chain and account abstraction superpowers.
content.description: Pillar is a community‑driven, self‑custody DeFi wallet that provides a single address across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Avalanche, and Multichain, enabling unified asset management without switching wallets. It emphasizes cross‑chain interoperability and gives you control of your funds as you interact with DeFi across multiple chains. With low to no gas fees, Pillar aims to make multi‑chain DeFi simpler and more accessible for everyday users.
content.meta: Pillar is a self-custody smart wallet with cross-chain and account abstraction superpowers. Discover Pillar and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
